name: Comtech Gold
oneLiner: CGO is ComTech's tokenized gold from the UAE, each token redeemable for 1 gram of 24K physical gold stored in DMCC-endorsed Transguard vaults.
collateral: Physical gold (999.9 fineness, 24-carat) stored in insured, segregated vaults with Transguard (Emirates Group) in the UAE; each bar registered on DMCC Tradeflow with unique ID and refiner certificates; 1 CGO = 1 gram of gold
pegMechanism: Direct redemption for physical gold coins via the ComTech Gold app; minimum physical delivery is 10 grams (in 1-gram multiples); gold movements endorsed and approved by DMCC

mintAuthority.summary: CGO is issued by ComTech Gold, a UAE custodian/trust company; tokens are minted when physical gold is added to Transguard-vaulted reserves and burned on redemption, all through the issuer's controlled tokenization process.

controls.label: ComTech Gold issuance/tokenization backend
controls.evidence: ComTech mints CGO on gold deposit and burns on redemption (≈0.2% tokenization fee) against gold held by Transguard under XDC Trust Company custody; supply is issuer-controlled with no permissionless mint.

review.evidence: Coverage and project materials describe ComTech Gold controlling a 1:1 mint/burn tied to physical gold deposits and redemptions on XDC; no user-collateralized or permissionless mint route exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on issuer/custodian model in project materials; the on-chain XRC-20 owner/minter address on XDC was not independently resolved (limited explorer transparency).
